# XTORC

XTORC is a globally trusted manufacturer and service provider of premium controlled bolting systems, high-pressure hydraulic equipment, and portable on-site machining tools. Proudly engineered and manufactured in India, XTORC delivers field-proven mechanical joint integrity solutions for heavy industries.

## Compliance and Certifications
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Certified quality management systems.
- **CE & ATEX**: Fully certified for operation in explosive, volatile, and high-risk environments.

---

## Core Product Offerings

### 1. Controlled Bolting Tools
- **Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrenches**: Compact, high-strength alloy design compatible with standard impact sockets.
  - [Square Drive Wrench](https://xtorcind.com/squaredrive)
- **Low-Profile Hex Drive Torque Wrenches**: Cassette-type hydraulic wrenches engineered for tight clearances and restricted access.
  - [Hex Drive Wrench](https://xtorcind.com/hexdrive)
- **Pneumatic Torque Wrenches**: Air-driven, explosion-proof torque wrenches for mining, gas pipeline, and refinery zones.
  - [Pneumatic Wrenches](https://xtorcind.com/pneumotic)
- **Electric Torque Wrenches**: Digital high-precision electric wrenches for repeatable torque preloads.
  - [Electric Wrenches](https://xtorcind.com/electrictorquewrenches)
- **Manual Torque Multipliers**: Hand-operated multipliers for high torque applications without power sources.
  - [Manual Torque Tools](https://xtorcind.com/manualtorque)

### 2. Bolt Tensioning Systems
- **Topside Bolt Tensioners**: High-pressure hydraulic tensioners ensuring uniform, leak-free flange preloading.
  - [Topside Tensioners](https://xtorcind.com/topsidebolt)
- **Spring Return Bolt Tensioners**: Rapid cycle tensioning featuring automatic piston retraction.
  - [Spring Return Tensioners](https://xtorcind.com/springreturnbolt)
- **Multi-Stage Bolt Tensioners**: Compact, high-stretch tensioners designed for wind turbine towers and steam turbines.
  - [Multi-Stage Tensioners](https://xtorcind.com/multistagebolt)
- **Subsea Bolt Tensioners**: Corrosion-resistant underwater tensioners built for offshore divers and ROVs.
  - [Subsea Tensioners](https://xtorcind.com/subseabolt)

### 3. On-Site Machining & Accessories
- **Pipe Cold Cutting & Beveling Machines**: Clamshell split-frame portable machines for safe, spark-free pipe edge prep.
  - [Pipe Cutting Machines](https://xtorcind.com/pipeCutting)
- **ID Pipe Bevelling Machines**: Inside-diameter mounted bevelers for pipeline weld preparation.
  - [ID Bevelling Machines](https://xtorcind.com/bevellingmachine)
- **Flange Facing Machines**: Portable OD/ID mounted flange facers for repairing damaged gasket surfaces.
  - [Flange Facers](https://xtorcind.com/flangefacing)
- **Hydraulic Nut Splitters**: Safe, spark-free cutting tools for removing seized or corroded nuts.
  - [Nut Splitters](https://xtorcind.com/hydralicnut)
- **High-Pressure Pumps**: 700 bar and 1500 bar electric (`XEP`) or pneumatic (`XAP`) pumps for torque wrenches and tensioners.
  - [Pumps and Power Packs](https://xtorcind.com/handPumps)
- **Impact Sockets & Reducers**: Industrial grade heat-treated socket attachments and adapters.
  - [Sockets & Accessories](https://xtorcind.com/socket)

---

## On-Site Engineering Services

XTORC provides professional, turnkey industrial services globally:
- **Bolt Torquing & Tensioning**: Flange joint assembly and structural bolting.
  - [Torquing Services](https://xtorcind.com/bolttorquing)
- **Cold Cutting & Beveling**: Spark-free pipeline modification and extraction.
  - [Cold Cutting Services](https://xtorcind.com/coldcutting)
- **Flange Facing Service**: On-site re-machining of RTJ and raised-face connections.
  - [Flange Facing Services](https://xtorcind.com/flangefacingservice)
- **Hot Tapping & Line Stopping**: Pipeline modifications under active flow without shutdown.
  - [Hot Tapping Services](https://xtorcind.com/hottapping)
- **Equipment Calibration**: NABL-traceable testing and certification of hydraulic torque wrenches.
  - [Calibration Services](https://xtorcind.com/retubbing)
- **Water Jet Cutting**: Ultra-high pressure cold water jet cutting services.
  - [Water Jet Services](https://xtorcind.com/waterjet)

---

## Industries We Serve
- **Oil & Gas / Refining**: Pipeline maintenance, refinery turnarounds, and platform assembly.
- **Power Generation**: Wind turbine installation, thermal/hydroelectric steam turbine maintenance.
- **Petrochemical & Fertilizer**: Vessel joint sealing, heat exchanger servicing.
- **Heavy Infrastructure**: Bridges, marine construction, structural steel bolting.
- [Industries Overview](https://xtorcind.com/industry)
